fixture_corrections.issue: A first fixed-app Raw cohort captured all images but failed the final retirement log-count assertion.
fixture_corrections.cause: native-editor retains a rolling 16 KiB log. Counting substrings in that window is not monotonic; older retirement events can fall out while a new event arrives.
fixture_corrections.fix: Count complete retirement lines on the owned stderr stream. Preserve the same retirement condition/deadline; all four final cohorts prove 6→7. Original capture-only pixels also passed.

fixture_corrections.issue: Intel Smooth's spatial rainbow comparison sampled exact 0.75-pixel stroke boundaries; two 2x subpixels could receive legal f32 coverage differences over different backgrounds.
fixture_corrections.fix: Use the existing odd-size resize image for spatial phase, with explicit assertions that both subpixels lie strictly inside the chosen lines. Preserve 2/255 tolerance, live-frame hue-change requirement and off-line background checks. No raster change or tolerance widening.

fixture_corrections.issue: The first final native-kernel PowerShell loop returned a wrapper status 1 after all tests reported success, because native stderr generated nonterminating PowerShell error records.
fixture_corrections.fix: Keep explicit per-native-process failure checks and exit 0 only after all pass. Rerun final six checks successfully; qualified log is retained.
